description.zh:
服务报警配置。
> 当**PolicyNames**中配置了报警权限策略后，该配置才会生效。
description.en:
The alert configurations for the service.

> This configuration takes effect only after you configure an alert-related access policy for **PolicyNames**.

description.zh:
服务使用申请审批类型。可能的值：

- Manual：收到审批。

- AutoPass：自动通过。
description.en:
The approval type for service usage requests. Valid values:

- Manual: The request is manually approved.

- AutoPass: The request is automatically approved.
The parameters for building the service.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent. You can use a client to generate the token. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
The commodity information.
The compliance check metadata.

description.zh: 存储服务部署配置的信息。存储的信息与部署类型有关，不同的部署类型存储的数据格式不一样，因此使用JSON String格式进行数据存储。
description.en: The information about the service deployment configuration. The data format varies based on the deployment type. The value is a JSON string.

description.zh:
部署类型。可能值：

- ros：通过ROS部署。

- terraform：通过Terraform部署。

- spi：调用SPI部署。

- operation：代运维服务部署。

- container：通过容器部署。

- pkg：包服务。
description.en:
The deployment type. Valid values:

- ros: The service is deployed using ROS.

- terraform: The service is deployed using Terraform.

- spi: The service is deployed by calling an SPI.

- operation: The service is an O\&M service.

- container: The service is deployed using containers.

- pkg: The service is a package service.

description.zh:
是否对此次请求执行预检，包括权限、实例状态校验等。可能的值：

- true：发送请求，不更新服务。

- false：发送请求，检查通过后更新服务。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for the request. A dry run checks the permissions and the instance status. Valid values:

- true: sends the request but does not update the service.

- false: sends the request. If the check is successful, the service is updated.
The O\&M duration. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
是否代运维，默认为：false。可能的值：

- true：开启。

- false：关闭。
> 当**ServiceType**为**private**时需要填入该值。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable O\&M. Default value: false. Valid values:

- true: enables O\&M.

- false: disables O\&M.

> This parameter is required when **ServiceType** is set to **private**.
The license metadata.
The application log configurations.
The O\&M configuration.

description.zh: 策略名称。单个策略名称长度不超过128个字符，多个名称使用英文逗号（,）分隔。暂时只支持代运维相关参数策略。
description.en: The policy name. The name of a single policy can be up to 128 characters in length. If you specify multiple policies, separate them with commas (,). Only O\&M-related policies are supported.
The region ID.

description.zh:
是否支持分销。可能的值：

- false：不支持。

- true：支持。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable distribution. Valid values:

- false: Distribution is not enabled.

- true: Distribution is enabled.
The service ID.
The service details.
The information about the service agreements.
The URL of the service icon.

description.zh:
服务语言。可能的值：

- zh-CN：中文。

- en-US：英文。
description.en:
The language of the service. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese.

- en-US: English.
The URL of the detailed description of the service.
The service name.
The description of the service.

description.zh: 服务中用到的软件信息。
description.en: The information about the software used in the service.
The multilingual configurations of the service.

description.zh: 业务信息对应的英文数据值
description.en: The English value of the business information.
The raw data value of the business information.

description.zh: 业务信息对应的中文数据值
description.en: The Chinese value of the business information.

description.zh:
服务类型。可能的值：

- private：部署在用户账户下的服务实例。

- managed：托管在服务商账户下的服务实例。

- operation：代运维服务实例

- poc：试用服务实例。
description.en:
The service type. Valid values:

- private: The service instance is deployed in the user account.

- managed: The service instance is deployed in the service provider account.

- operation: The service instance is an O\&M instance.

- poc: The service instance is a trial instance.
The service version.

description.zh:
共享类型。可能的值：

- Public：公开的，正式部署和试用部署都不受限。

- Restricted：受限的，正式部署和试用部署都受限。

- OnlyFormalRestricted：仅正式部署受限。

- OnlyTrailRestricted：仅试用部署受限。

- Hidden：隐藏的，不可见且不可申请部署权限。
description.en:
The sharing type. Valid values:

- Public: The service is public. Formal and trial deployments are not restricted.

- Restricted: The service is restricted. Formal and trial deployments are restricted.

- OnlyFormalRestricted: Only formal deployments are restricted.

- OnlyTrailRestricted: Only trial deployments are restricted.

- Hidden: The service is hidden. You cannot view the service or request deployment permissions.

description.zh:
租户类型。可能的值：

- SingleTenant：单租户。

- MultiTenant：多租户。
description.en:
The tenant type. Valid values:

- SingleTenant: The service is single-tenant.

- MultiTenant: The service is multi-tenant.

description.zh: 试用时长。单位：天。试用时长的最长天数不超过30天。
description.en: The trial duration. Unit: days. The maximum trial duration is 30 days.
The update options.
The upgrade metadata.
The version name.

descriptions.zh: 需要上线的服务必须为已通过审核的服务。
descriptions.en: Only approved services can be published.
